## 0. 重要更新说明

- 本次升级包含新的 Engine 拨号计划；更新会逐条重建 VoWiFi Engine，线路会短暂中断并重新
  注册，正在进行的通话会挂断。请在没有重要通话时升级。
- “收到提醒后再登录接听”只在来电仍处于配置的振铃窗口内有效。对方先挂断或窗口超时后，
  来电会按现有设置进入未接记录或语音留言，不会重新制造一通电话。

## 1. v1.6.0 本次版本更新

- 浏览器不再需要预先停留在“通话”页。网关在浏览器离线时保持来电，管理员收到通知后打开并
  登录 WebUI，系统会自动注册全部已启用线路，并在任意页面显示全局接听/拒接弹窗。
- Webhook、Telegram 和 PushPlus 现在都能按来电、短信、未接来电等事件分别自定义标题和正文，
  支持变量提示、即时预览、当前事件测试推送和一键恢复默认。留空继续使用原文案；模板只做变量
  替换，不能执行代码。Webhook 标准载荷新增渲染后的 `title`/`content`，自定义载荷也可引用。
- 首次打开、切换线路或刷新状态时，不再先闪现“未注册”“无 SIM 卡”“无记录”“未连接”或默认
  配置再改成真实状态；通话、设备、日志、余额、保号、eSIM、代理、通知及系统设置在数据返回前
  统一显示加载状态，接口失败也不会再伪装成空数据，真实故障仍会在确认后正常显示。
- 修复 [Issue #22](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/22)：一台设备正在开启或关闭
  VoWiFi、4G 或飞行模式时切换到另一台设备，不再把前一台设备的“正在开启/关闭”提示带过去；
  每台设备和每项能力的临时状态现在彼此隔离。
- 修复 [Issue #26](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/26)：实体 eSIM 已切换成功时，
  基带缓存的旧 ICCID 可能让页面误报失败、继续显示旧卡或让新旧线路同时启用。现在直接以卡片
  身份为准，并明确区分“切换成功但线路恢复失败”。
- 修复 [Issue #27](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/27)：分享链接中的 Hysteria2
  混淆、完整认证串和 ALPN 不再丢失；不支持的传输会明确拒绝。节点测试显示脱敏解析摘要和真实
  失败阶段，VLESS REALITY 自动由内置 Xray-core 处理。

## 2. v1.6.0 功能概览

- 来电通知成为可操作的接听入口：登录后不必选择 SIM 或导航到特定页面。
- eSIM 切换以卡片实况而不是基带缓存为准，页面、设备状态和线路恢复结果保持一致。
- 国家出口能保留常见分享链接参数、选择合适的代理内核，并把失败原因显示在测试结果中。

---

## 0. Important upgrade notes

- This release includes a new Engine dialplan. The update rebuilds VoWiFi Engines one line at a
  time; each line briefly disconnects and registers again, and an active call will be dropped.
  Upgrade when no important call is in progress.
- “Open the browser after a notification and answer” works only while the caller remains inside
  the configured ringing window. If the caller hangs up or the window expires, the existing
  missed-call or voicemail behavior applies; the gateway does not create a new call.

## 1. v1.6.0 release changes

- The browser no longer has to be left on the Calls page. While it is offline the gateway holds
  the incoming call; after the administrator opens and signs in to the WebUI, every enabled line
  registers automatically and a global Answer/Decline overlay appears on any page.
- Webhook, Telegram and PushPlus can now customize title and content independently for calls,
  messages, missed calls and every other notification event, with variable hints, live preview,
  per-event test delivery and one-click restore. Blank templates keep the existing wording, and
  field-only substitution cannot execute code. Standard and custom webhooks can both consume the
  rendered `title` and `content` fields.
- Initial open, line switching and refresh no longer flash “Unregistered”, “No SIM”, “No records”,
  “Not connected” or default settings before real data arrives. Calls, devices, logs, allowance,
  keeping, eSIM, proxy, notifications and system settings now show a loading state while pending;
  request failures no longer masquerade as empty data, while confirmed faults still appear normally.
- Fixed [Issue #22](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/22): switching devices while
  VoWiFi, cellular data or flight mode was being enabled or disabled no longer carries the first
  device's temporary starting/stopping display into the second; pending state is isolated by
  device and capability.
- Fixed [Issue #26](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/26): after a physical eSIM
  had switched successfully, a stale ICCID cached by the baseband could make the page report
  failure, keep showing the old SIM, or leave old and new lines enabled together. Card identity
  is now authoritative, and “switched but line recovery failed” is reported separately.
- Fixed [Issue #27](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/27): pasted links retain
  Hysteria2 obfuscation, the complete authentication string, and ALPN, while unsupported transports
  are rejected explicitly. Node tests show a redacted parse summary and the real failure stage;
  VLESS REALITY is handled automatically by the bundled Xray-core.

## 2. v1.6.0 feature overview

- A call notification becomes an actionable pickup path: after sign-in, no SIM selection or page
  navigation is required.
- eSIM switching follows live card identity instead of stale baseband state, keeping the page,
  device status, and line-recovery result consistent.
- Country exits preserve common share-link parameters, choose the appropriate proxy engine, and
  expose actionable failure reasons in node-test results.
